summary: Completed UI testing of the LiveSpectatorView.js component after the major UI/UX overhaul. All 10 test scenarios passed. The new design shows video stream and events/stats simultaneously (side-by-side on desktop, stacked on mobile). Tab buttons have high contrast with white text and blue underline.
critical_code_review_comments: TeamLogo component uses correct sizes: 'w-16 h-16 md:w-20 md:h-20' - 64px mobile, 80px desktop
Tab buttons have proper contrast: active='text-white bg-white/10 border-b-2 border-blue-400', inactive='text-white/50'
Layout uses flex-col for stacked on mobile (md:flex-row for desktop side-by-side)
All data-testid attributes present: live-spectator-view, spectator-events-tab, spectator-stats-tab, spectator-chat-toggle, spectator-close-btn, stream-iframe, chat-input, chat-send-btn
StatBar component correctly displays Goals, Shots, Assists comparison bars
Top performers sections show 'No scoring yet' when no player stats available
test_credentials: No login required - guest access to LiveSpectatorView
seed_data_creation: Used existing 'SHOT Button Test Game' event with 'in_progress' status
context_for_next_testing_agent: LiveSpectatorView UI/UX overhaul is complete. Navigate: Events page > Detailed view > Click green 'Live' button on 'SHOT Button Test Game'. The view shows stream on left, events/stats panel on right (desktop), or stacked vertically (mobile).

desktop_side_by_side_layout.details: Stream on left, events/stats panel on right at 1920x1080 viewport

mobile_stacked_layout.details: Scoreboard, stream, then events/stats below at 390x844 viewport

team_logos_large_in_scoreboard.details: TeamLogo uses 'w-16 h-16' mobile, 'w-20 h-20' desktop as per requirements

events_tab_toggle.details: Events tab shows game events or 'No events yet' message

stats_tab_toggle.details: Stats tab shows Goals/Shots/Assists bars and top performers sections

stats_tab_comparison_bars.details: Shows Home Team vs Away Team with colored progress bars

stats_tab_top_performers.details: Shows Home Team and Away Team sections with 'No scoring yet' when empty

chat_button_toggle.details: Chat button toggles panel open/closed, shows input field when open

close_button.details: X button closes spectator view and returns to events page

top_bar_elements.details: Shows LIVE badge (red animated), event title, Chat button, X close button

high_contrast_tabs.details: Active tab: white text, bg-white/10, blue-400 underline. Good contrast on dark background.

data_testid_verification.stream-iframe: PRESENT - YouTube iframe when youtubeUrl exists
